snippet.title: RAMAYANA – Official Trailer – In Cinemas November 5, 2026
snippet.description:
An epic journey unlike anything seen before. Watch the official trailer for #Ramayana, coming to Australian cinemas November 5.

Sony Pictures and Prime Focus Studios, in association with DNEG and Monster Mind Creations, present the official trailer for Namit Malhotra’s Ramayana, bringing one of humanity’s most enduring epics to the global stage. 

A landmark cinematic adaptation told on an unprecedented scale, the saga is helmed by acclaimed director Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra. The action-adventure fantasy stars South Asian superstars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi, featuring a score by Academy Award® winners Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman, and groundbreaking visual effects from eight-time Oscar® winning visual effects company, DNEG.

About Namit Malhotra’s Ramayana
In an age of gods and kings, the fate of worlds hangs in the balance. Rama, a prince bound by duty, sacrifice, and righteousness, must confront Ravana, an immortal ruler driven by pride and vengeance, powerful enough to shatter the cosmos.

Directed by: Nitesh Tiwari
Starring: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi

Produced by: Namit Malhotra
Music: Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman
Adaptation by: Shridhar Raghavan, Nitesh Tiwari
Editing by: Huzefa Lokhandwala
Production Design by: Ravi Bansal, Ramsey Avery
Action Design by: Guy Norris, Terry Notary
Costume Design by: Rimple & Harpreet Narula and Saniya Sardhariya
Visual Effects by: Dan Glass

IN CINEMAS NOVEMBER 5, 2026
#Ramayana

snippet.description:
Everything ends here. Experience GODZILLA MINUS ZERO, the first-ever Japanese production #FilmedForIMAX, in theatres November 6.

GODZILLA MINUS ZERO
VFX, Written, and Directed by Takashi Yamazaki
In theatres November 6
Follow @godzilla_toho and @GKIDSfilms for more updates!
godzillaminuszero.com

War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.
 
There is no third time. Everything ends here.

Shot entirely in Japan as the first-ever Japanese production to be Filmed For IMAX, GODZILLA MINUS ZERO was shot with high-definition digital cameras certified by IMAX, and optimized in sound and imagery unique to IMAX screens. The globally beloved monster returns to movie theater screens reaching greater and more terrifying heights, making GODZILLA MINUS ZERO a true cinematic event not to be missed.

snippet.title: Waiting Hai - Official Trailer | Divyenndu Sharma, Bhuvan Arora, Harshita Gaur | Prime Video
snippet.description:
Waiting Hai - Official Trailer

Cast: Divyenndu Sharma, Bhuvan Arora, Harshita Gaur, Kumud Mishra, Vijay Maurya, Sunita Rajwar, Yashpal Sharma

Presented By: Jio Studios
Production House: Jio Studios & Jar Pictures 
Produced by: Jyoti Deshpande & Ajay Rai 
Directed By: Sameer Vidwans 
Written By: Shreyas Jain 
Genre: Scam Dramedy

About the Show: A scam drama based on Tatkal ticketing on Indian Railways, designed as a cat and mouse game between a newly joined Railway Police officer Sugam Mishra, played by Divyenndu and a nerd computer geek, Afroz Hamsa, Played by Bhuvan Arora who makes a software to book confirmed tickets by hacking into railway website to impress a pretty girl. When the girl takes the tickets and humiliates him in front of the college, Hamza is left dejected, but his schemer Mama sees a business opportunity in this and together they set up their network of twenty thousand tatkal agents all across the country. Meanwhile, Sugam Mishra, eager to earn respect for himself with Railway Police, sets out to expose the scam.

About Prime Video:
Prime Video is India’s largest streaming service for exclusive Originals — a one-stop entertainment destination in India offering blockbuster Originals and exclusive titles included with Prime, in addition to the widest a selection of movie rentals, and 30+ add-on subscriptions (Apple TV+, Lionsgate Play, Discovery+ Crunchyroll, BBC Player, Sony Pictures – Stream, MGM+ to name a few). With the integration of the free video streaming service ‘Amazon MX Player’ into Prime Video, the unified service now offers a deeper, richer selection for an even wider base of audiences in India, with a variety of Indian and international movies and shows across Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, and more. Prime Video is home to fan-favorites like Mirzapur, The Family Man, Panchayat, Paatal Lok, Farzi, Raakh, Subedaar, Matka King, Call Me Bae, Dhootha, Inspector Rishi, Traitors, Rise & Fall, Sankalp, Jamnapaar, Aashram and Made In India: A Titan Story. Global hits include Project Hail Mary, Off Campus, The Boys,  The Lord of The Rings: The Rings of Power, Jack Ryan, The Summer I Turned Pretty, amongst others. Prime Video offers every kind of entertainment, for every kind of viewer, all in one place. For more information on Prime Video, visit www.amazon.com/primevideo.

Ke dhar rakhya tanne jholi me?
Dharu kaala asla jholi me,
Ke dhar rakhya s jholi me?
Dharu kaala asla jholi me.

snippet.title: Remain | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
She's unlike anybody he's ever met. From M. Night Shyamalan, #RemainMovie is in theaters Valentine's Day 2027.

From Warner Bros. Pictures, Remain, starring Jake Gyllenhaal, is an unprecedented collaboration between two of the world’s most creative minds: best-selling author Nicholas Sparks, and visionary filmmaker M. Night Shyamalan.

When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

Gyllenhaal stars alongside Phoebe Dynevor, Ashley Walters, Julie Hagerty and Jay O. Sanders.

Shyamalan directs from his own screenplay, story by Shyamalan and Sparks. The film is produced by Shyamalan, Ashwin Rajan, Marc Bienstock and Theresa Park, with Sparks executive producing.

Joining Shyamalan behind the camera are director of photography Adolpho Veloso, production designer Sam Lisenco, editor Noëmi Preiswerk, costume designer Caroline Duncan, casting director Douglas Aibel, music supervisor Gabe Hilfer and composer James Newton Howard.

Warner Bros. Pictures Presents a Blinding Edge Pictures Production, an M. Night Shyamalan Film, Remain, in theaters across North America February 5, 2027, and internationally beginning 3 February 2027, distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures.

snippet.title: LISA - Always Lalisa (Official Trailer)
snippet.description:
ALWAYS LALISA
In Cinemas & IMAX Worldwide, October 12
Ticket at https://alwayslalisa.com

Always Lalisa is a feature-length documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from Blackpink, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. As the group pauses activities, LISA embarks on the first true chapter of her solo career, confronting the question of who she is beyond Blackpink.

The film follows LISA as she writes, records, and releases her debut solo album, Alter Ego, makes her acting debut in the third season of The White Lotus, and prepares for her first major solo performance at the 2025 Coachella Music Festival. Born and raised in Thailand, LISA left home at fourteen to train in South Korea's demanding K-pop system, ultimately rising to global superstardom. But forging her own path, particularly in the Western music market, brings new pressures, relentless scrutiny, and the challenge of redefining herself on her own terms.

Intimate, emotional, and revealing, Always Lalisa captures an artist at a crossroads, documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define not only her next chapter, but the woman and artist she wants to become.

snippet.description:

Artist: Alka Yagnik | Udit Narayan

Lyricist: Rishi Azad

After the chaotic visit from the Chaddi Gang, Jack decides it's time to safely send everyone—Shinchan, Nobita, Chacha, Priya, and the rest of the gang—back to their homes.
